Each segment varies in width, depth, and height, creating a sense of dynamic construction and vertical progression. The color palette shifts gradually through muted industrial tones as the structure ascends, using HSB color mode to maintain visual coherence. The scene automatically evolves over time with new segments added periodically, simulating continuous urban development.
